Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
An amusement center sounds like so much fun! Thanks for bringing me.
You're welcome. I'm getting excited too, ●!
Anegasaki
We get to hang out together again. I really wanted to come!
Me too, ●. Now then, what should we start with...？
Anegasaki
Are we doing video games or medal games today？ I'm good with either!
All right, then...
Anegasaki
Hehe, this again？ You never get tired of it, do you.
Yeah. Let's make the most of it!
Anegasaki
Jeez, this again？ Alright, I'll stick with you to the very end.
Haha, thanks.
Anegasaki
Not 30 was really fun♪ I'd love to play again.
Sure, I'll play with you anytime.
Anegasaki
Someone in my class used to play Not 30. They said they never lost.
Huh, so there must be some trick to it.
Anegasaki
Daruma-san ga koronda is kind of a tongue-twister if you say it fast, huh？
Maybe that frustration is what makes it fun.
Anegasaki
Daaaruma-san♪ Daaaruma-san♪ ...Wait, was that for the staring contest？
Daruma-san shows up a lot in these kinds of games, doesn't he.
Anegasaki
Watermelon splitting is so fun. It's just a shame it ends up hard to eat.
Yeah, not like we can slice it cleanly in two like a master swordsman.
Anegasaki
Watermelon splitting... I'm always scared I'll hit someone on the sand by mistake. It's a bit scary.
I'd definitely freak out if someone whacked me...
Anegasaki
Marshmallow toss really tests your compatibility. You have to be in sync or it won't work.
...That's low-key a lot of pressure.
Anegasaki
Marshmallows are yummy, but... I've gotta make sure not to eat too many.
(So she does worry about that after all...)
Anegasaki
I focused so hard I might have gone cross-eyed. Darts is so much fun♪
Just throwing it straight is surprisingly tough.
Anegasaki
A dartboard in my room sounds pretty fun...
Hmm, you might end up getting hooked.
Anegasaki
I'm not great at Speed, but... I still really like it♪
You definitely looked like you were having fun, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Truth is, I once got so into Speed I jammed my finger. You be careful, too, okay？
This game's surprisingly like a sport, huh...
Anegasaki
Bubbles are so fun. I feel like a kid again♪
(Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ act so innocent is cute, too...)
Anegasaki
Speaking of soap bubbles, bubble baths are actually pretty tricky, you know？ They don't lather up easily.
Huh, a bubble bath, is it...
Anegasaki
Fufu, that was fun♪ If we ever fight, maybe we should settle things with this.
Sounds like I'd take a painful hit or two...
Anegasaki
This game might not be fair to play guy versus girl. It's hard for a boy to hit a girl, after all？
Mm, yeah, fair point.
Anegasaki
This game is so much more fun when you play with someone you're really close to♪
Haha, like pulling unexpected mind games on each other.
Anegasaki
With this game, you can win without much strength if you outsmart them... Hehehe.
Haha, that smile is scary.
Anegasaki
This is fun! I might actually be pretty good at beating them？
Huh, that's kind of surprising.
Anegasaki
Hey, if aliens really did invade, would you protect me？
Of course! I won't let them lay a single finger on you!
Anegasaki
It's hard deciding which panel to pick. I can't quite calculate it all...
Why not just follow your gut？
Anegasaki
If you get lured by the medals right in front of you, you're stuck on the next pick.
Yeah, gotta plan ahead at least a little bit...
Anegasaki
Watching the cute characters toddle along is so adorable～
Totally. Just watching them move is fun on its own.
Anegasaki
No jackpot, huh？ That was so close.
Aww, so frustrating!
Anegasaki
That went great♪ We even got the jackpot!
Yeah, I almost shouted out loud.
Anegasaki
Grand Cross shows so many different worlds, I'm satisfied just watching it.
Just watching is nice, but I want to win some medals too.
Anegasaki
If we'd hit the Grand Cross jackpot, it looked like it would've been so fun... What a shame.
Next time, I'll do my best and show you all the way to the end!
Anegasaki
We won the Grand Cross jackpot! I was totally mesmerized by that.
Medals came pouring out, too. That was so flashy!
Anegasaki
Fortune Trinity showed famous places all over the world. Maybe it's good geography study？
Hmm, studying while playing, huh...
Anegasaki
Fortune Trinity was so close to a jackpot. Time for revenge next visit？
Yeah, next time for sure, I'll show ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ all those famous sights around the world!
Anegasaki
Fortune Trinity's jackpot was so exhilarating! The screen split in two and everything!
Yeah, talk about a nice surprise.
Anegasaki
All the animals in Anima Lotta are so cute, ▼ I wonder if those plushies are in any claw machines？
Yeah, maybe we can look for one next time.
Anegasaki
I really wanted to see that Anima Lotta jackpot... We were so close, weren't we？
A ton of balls come pouring out, it's super intense...
Anegasaki
Congrats on the Anima Lotta jackpot. It was so pretty... I was honestly moved.
The presentation is so good. Too bad you hardly ever get to see it.
Anegasaki
Whenever Jackpot Chance comes up, I'm praying, 'Go in!' in my head. Didn't work out today, though.
Is that so？ Well, let's hope for better luck next time.
Anegasaki
I love the suspense of a Jackpot Chance. When someone else gets one, I want to go peek.
I'll nail it next time, just watch!
Anegasaki
The highlight today was... your face when you hit that jackpot, I think？
You were watching me？ Man, that's embarrassing...
Anegasaki
I'm so glad we came today. I got to see something amazing.
The jackpot, right？ Hitting that feels so good!
Anegasaki
You get to play and win a ton of medals too, so medal games are a win-win, right♪
Haha, though you don't always win that many...
Anegasaki
Watching all those medals pour out just makes it more and more fun.
Haha, just don't get too carried away, okay？
Anegasaki
We got quite a lot of medals. I feel so rich♪
I'll win even more for us, just you wait.
Anegasaki
We lost some medals, but we had so much fun, so it's all good, right？
Yeah... I guess I'll look at it that way.
Anegasaki
Today was so much fun♪ Hey, did you have fun too？
Of course！
Anegasaki
Fufu. The look on your face when you're totally absorbed is so cute▼
You were looking at me that much？ I didn't even notice...
Anegasaki
We got so absorbed in it, we completely lost track of time.
Seriously, time just flew by.
Anegasaki
It's been so long since I got this excited♪
Yeah, it feels amazing.
Anegasaki
Thanks for bringing me along. I'd hardly ever come here alone.
I had a lot of fun playing together with you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
I feel like things went pretty well, so I want to come again... Can we？
Yeah, let's do that.
Anegasaki
Next time we come, let's do even better. I'll be cheering for you.
If you're cheering for me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I'll definitely give it my all.
Anegasaki
The results were frustrating, though. Let's do our best next time.
Yeah, it just doesn't feel right unless we go home on a win.
Anegasaki
Yeah, it would've been nice to end it on a win.
We'll get our revenge next time.
Anegasaki
...Still, maybe we could've done a little better.
Maybe... Next time, let's get real results!
Alright, let's give it a shot.
Silver, huh... Gotta be careful here.
Gold, huh... Here's my chance!
Platinum？ This could be good!
Premium... The legendary scratch card!? I wonder what's gonna come out...
Anegasaki
Maybe the right one？ Just a hunch, though.
Anegasaki
My intuition says... the left. Yep, definitely left.
Anegasaki
Let's go for the middle! ...What do you think？
Anegasaki
Left... or right？ Or do the unexpected and pick the middle...？
Anegasaki
Why don't you show me how cool you can be？ I'm leaving it to you!
Anegasaki
I trust your intuition. Good luck!
All right, I won!
It's a winner! ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s intuition is amazing...
It's a winner! Glad I could live up to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s expectations.
...Dang it, it's a dud.
A dud... Maybe I should've gone with the one ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ picked.
